title: The Toad
summary: Deep at the bottom of an old muddy well lived a mother toad and her little ones. The mother croaked: "The world is this damp well and the wet stones!"...
full_text:
Deep at the bottom of an old muddy well lived a mother toad and her little ones. The mother croaked: "The world is this damp well and the wet stones!"

Yet the little toad looked up through the dark shaft at the tiny patch of blue sky and the sparkling star at night: "There must be something higher, something radiant above!"

With heroic determination, the little toad climbed the slimy brick walls, inch by inch, tumbling down, bleeding, and rising again until he reached the grass above!

He was swallowed by a stork, which flew high into the clouds toward the golden sun. Even as he died, the toad looked into the blinding glory of the light, feeling that the precious jewel hidden within his ugly head had returned to the celestial source of all beauty.
moral: The outward form may be humble and despised, yet a jewel of divine aspiration rests within.
